passage.label: Al-Baqarah — righteousness is not turning faces east or west but belief in Allah, Last Day, angels, Book, prophets; giving wealth despite love to relatives, orphans, needy, traveler, askers, freeing slaves; establishing prayer; giving zakah; fulfilling covenants; patience in poverty, hardship, battle; those are truthful and muttaqoon; qisas prescribed for murder: free for free, slave for slave, female for female; remission by brother followed kindly with good conduct; alleviation and mercy from Rabb; transgressor after that has painful punishment; in qisas there is life O people of understanding so you may attain taqwa; bequest prescribed when death approaches if leaving wealth for parents and near relatives bil-ma'ruf; duty on muttaqeen; whoever alters bequest after hearing it sin is on alterers; Allah Samee' Aleem; whoever fears error/sin from bequeather and reconciles no sin on him; Allah Ghafoor Raheem

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞لَّيۡسَ ٱلۡبِرَّ أَن تُوَلُّواْ وُجُوهَكُمۡ قِبَلَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡبِرَّ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَءَاتَى ٱلۡمَالَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ ذَوِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱبۡنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَٱلسَّآئِلِينَ وَفِي ٱلرِّقَابِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلۡمُوفُونَ بِعَهۡدِهِمۡ إِذَا عَٰهَدُواْۖ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡبَأۡسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَحِينَ ٱلۡبَأۡسِۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُواْۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡقِصَاصُ فِي ٱلۡقَتۡلَىۖ ٱلۡحُرُّ بِٱلۡحُرِّ وَٱلۡعَبۡدُ بِٱلۡعَبۡدِ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ بِٱلۡأُنثَىٰۚ فَمَنۡ عُفِيَ لَهُۥ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ شَيۡءٞ فَٱتِّبَاعُۢ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَأَدَآءٌ إِلَيۡهِ بِإِحۡسَٰنٖۗ ذَٰلِكَ تَخۡفِيفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَةٞۗ فَمَنِ ٱعۡتَدَىٰ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡقِصَاصِ حَيَوٰةٞ يَـٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيۡرًا ٱلۡوَصِيَّةُ لِلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
فَمَنۢ بَدَّلَهُۥ بَعۡدَ مَا سَمِعَهُۥ فَإِنَّمَآ إِثۡمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ
فَمَنۡ خَافَ مِن مُّوصٖ جَنَفًا أَوۡ إِثۡمٗا فَأَصۡلَحَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فَلَآ إِثۡمَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: Comprehensive definition of birr (righteousness): faith pillars plus charitable spending, prayer, zakah, covenant-keeping, patience in adversity; truthful and righteous identified; legal retribution (qisas) prescribed with proportionality; remission encouraged with good conduct; qisas as alleviation and mercy containing life; bequest (wasiyyah) prescribed for parents and relatives; prohibition of altering bequests; reconciliation of bequest errors permitted; divine attributes Samee' Aleem and Ghafoor Raheem

subordinateSubjects.label: Birr redefined: not directional piety but comprehensive faith and action
Five faith pillars: Allah, Last Day, angels, Book, prophets
Charitable spending despite love: relatives, orphans, needy, traveler, askers, slaves
Patience in ba'sa', darra', and hin al-ba's
Remission by brother: follow with ma'ruf and ihsan
Qisas as takhfeef and rahmah from Rabb
In qisas there is life for people of understanding
Wasiyyah prescribed for parents and relatives
Reconciliation of bequest error: no sin
